Six files use `convertFromSmallestToPresentableCurrencyUnit` from `packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts`, counting the defining file, which calls it internally. None of them are test files; a search for the name found no tests.

- **`packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts`** defines the function and calls it itself at line 69.
- **`packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.ts`** imports it from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions` and calls it at line 89.
- **`packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx`** calls it at line 85.
- **`packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx`** calls it at line 111.
- **`packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts`** calls it at line 113.
- **`packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx`** calls it at line 92.

Three other files have a function with the same name but are not users of the `packages/lib` one, so I left them out:

- **`packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts`** defines its own copy.
- **`packages/app-store/btcpayserver/lib/currencyOptions.ts`** defines its own copy.
- **BTCPay Server's `PaymentService.ts` and `EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx`** use that BTCPay copy, imported from `./currencyOptions`.

Four other files import from `currencyConversions` but not this function: `handlePayment.ts`, `Price.tsx`, `FormBuilder.tsx` and `BookingDetailsSheet.tsx`. `BaseScheduledEmail.tsx` also imports from that path, and I didn't open it. The name search didn't match it, so it doesn't call this function.
